explained.hub.title: How 6529 works, and how we know.
explained.hub.mission: 6529 is a community around The Memes, CC0 art cards chosen by vote and minted on Ethereum, {perWeek} a week; each whole day you hold one adds to your Total Days Held (TDH), which weighs those votes.
explained.hub.station.artSay: Every {days} a new card is minted on Ethereum, CC0, about {copies} copies.
explained.hub.station.holdSay: Copies sit in wallets. Up to four wallets count as one identity.
explained.hub.station.timeSay: One copy of Meme #2 earns {rate} a day: {h}, the largest edition, ÷ its {edition} copies. A hundred whole days give the number above.
explained.hub.station.standingSay: Your TDH plus your xTDH sets how much Rep and NIC (Network Identity Check) you can give, and both count toward your Level with the Rep you receive. xTDH is a separate score, never TDH: what other holders grant you, and what the cards you hold produce and you have not granted away.
explained.hub.station.decideSay: Main Stage weighs votes by TDH and picks a card {perWeek} times a week.
explained.hub.station.executeSay: Today 6529's admin keys mint the winner. Minting by the network is decided (D67), not built.
explained.hub.chapterComing: Explained in {title}, a chapter still coming.
explained.hub.verifyNote.label: At the centre
explained.hub.verifyNote.body: A strong check, not a proof: logs are not yet checked against block headers.
explained.hub.check.label: Three things checked
explained.hub.check.identitiesBody: 6529.io's TDH equals two separately written recomputations in all {days} results since {first}.
explained.hub.check.identitiesSome: 6529.io's TDH equals two separately written recomputations today, and in {equal} of the {days} results since {first}.
explained.hub.check.identitiesLateEqual: {late} were written late or re-run (↻); those are equal too.
explained.hub.check.theoremsBody: About a model of TDH's rules; {p53} more are about the proposed validator rules, written before the cap changed. Lean proves things about rules, never a day. {shownFalse} statements about TDH shown false ({allFalse} in all) stay on record; only 6529 can rerun them today.
explained.hub.check.proof: One real day, half a pair
explained.hub.check.proofBody: A zero-knowledge proof lets a contract check a program's result without rerunning it; a day needs one from each of two programs. Program A proved {day} under retired rules, and mainnet's verifier accepted it read-only; both have proved a test cycle under TDH v1.4. Nothing is on Ethereum yet (D128).
explained.hub.check.proofWhen: Proof A of {day}, made {date}; proof B not yet
explained.hub.check.candour: Today 6529 runs both recomputations and 6529.io's own. Anyone can check each day's file against the index (hashed, not signed) and add up 6529.io's signed upload. Recomputing a day needs your own program and Ethereum's logs, as 6529's are private (D116).
explained.hub.check.yours: Your TDH is in each of those results: see yours.

explained.hub.cc0.label: CC0, in one minute
explained.hub.cc0.title: The art is free. Holding is what counts.
explained.hub.cc0.body: The Memes are dedicated to the public domain under CC0, Creative Commons' “No Rights Reserved” tool: anyone may copy, remix and sell the art without asking. What holding gives you is TDH.
explained.hub.cc0.give: Your copyright in the image, to everyone, under CC0, for good: the dedication cannot be withdrawn.
explained.hub.cc0.keepBody: {own} copies of each of your cards, and {choice} more to give to people you choose; like any holder's, they earn TDH. Half of each paid mint is yours (D79). From {from} the team, museum and fund airdrops end (D91): these become a card's only free copies.
explained.hub.cc0.unstated: Credit when your card is used: CC0 asks for none, and 6529 has written no norm yet.
explained.hub.cc0.model.label: Where can this image go?
explained.hub.cc0.model.q: Pick a work and a use.
explained.hub.cc0.model.memeSay: The artist dedicated the card to the public domain, as 6529.io's license page records: anyone may copy, change and sell it, for any purpose.
explained.hub.cc0.model.adSay: The deed asks that an ad not suggest the artist endorses it.
explained.hub.cc0.model.oneSay: Meme Card #1 is CC0, but it shows a CryptoPunk, whose copyright was never the artist's to give, and the CryptoPunks trademark is not released either. CC0 releases only the artist's own rights.
explained.hub.cc0.model.punkSay: The CryptoPunk in Meme Card #1 was never the artist's to give. CC0 waives only the artist's own rights, and it waives no trademark, so using the Punk itself needs the permission of whoever holds its rights.
explained.hub.cc0.model.break: use the Punk in Meme Card #1
explained.hub.cc0.model.gradSay: 6529 Gradients are not CC0: 6529 reserves their rights. It does not mind them in art and memes, but asks that no use suggest a product is offered by 6529.
explained.hub.cc0.model.leaves: Not covered: trademarks, and others' rights in a card's subject. Ask a lawyer about a real case.
explained.hub.cc0.model.gradLeaves: 6529's own policy for its Gradients, from 6529.io's license page. Ask a lawyer about a real case.
explained.hub.cc0.model.ruleTm: CC0 §4: no trademark waived; others' rights stay
explained.hub.cc0.limit: CC0 stops at 6529 Gradients, which are not CC0, and at others' rights, such as the CryptoPunk in Meme Card #1.
explained.hub.guide.label: Reading the marks
explained.hub.guide.title: Every claim answers up to four questions.
explained.hub.guide.body: A shape answers each, and a word says it too. A decision is never green: decided is not the same as true.
explained.hub.guide.proved: in Lean, or in zero knowledge; a retired rule is named beside it
explained.hub.guide.sinceLive: Every live number says when it was read or written.
explained.hub.guide.drift: named where it changes what a block says.
